newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Central Bank sells 5.728 bln reais in bonds.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Central Bank sells 5.728 bln reais in bonds.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold 5.728 billion reais in 56-day and 182-day Central Bank Bonds (BBCs) at its weekly formal bond auction Tuesday, dealers said.
The Central Bank sold 4.366 billion reais in 56-day bonds at an overnight rate of 2.4535 percent a month, down from 2.5597 percent last week.
The 182-day bonds were sold at 2.324 percent a month, down from 2.411 percent, totalling 1.362 billion reais.
The auction's result was in line with market expectations, dealers said.
The financial result of the auction indicated 772 million reais will be added to the banking system as 6.5 billion reais of 56-day old bonds roll off Wednesday.
